Twenty thousand people, eighty five meters underground... so how did they breathe?
The answer is in these shafts.
More than fifty ventilation shafts run from the surface of Derinkuyu down to the deepest floors.
Fresh air sinks in. Stale air rises out. No machines at all.
Some shafts even reach groundwater, so they doubled as wells.
It stays thirteen to fifteen degrees down there, all year round.
Twenty thousand people... and not one of them needed a window.
